import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Create a DataFrame from the given data
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Pivot the DataFrame to count transactions by hour of day and transaction type
pivot_df = df.pivot_table(index='hour_of_day', columns='transaction_type', values='amount', aggfunc='count')

# Create a heatmap using seaborn
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.heatmap(pivot_df, annot=True, cmap='Blues')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Count by Hour of Day and Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Hour of Day')

# Show the plot
